intro.zh: 8 卡 A100 上的固定长度与自然输出测试；思考开启，实际 effort 75 逐条核验。
intro.en: Fixed-length and natural-output measurements on eight A100s, with thinking enabled and effort 75 verified per request.

note.zh: 固定输出使用 ignore EOS，部分响应只有 reasoning；缓存命中率差异很大。各点为单次起服观测，关键点另有复测；未做任务精度评测。
note.en: Fixed output uses ignore EOS and some responses contain only reasoning. Cache-hit rates vary widely. Points are from one server start, with separate repeats for key points; task accuracy was not assessed.

intro.en: Representative measured points from the report; C denotes client concurrency.

notes.zh: 8K/512 C32 的服务端计数器存在采样告警；固定长度、自然结束和超长专项不可混算，超长结论以逐请求计时补测为准。
notes.en: The server counter at 8K/512 C32 had sampling warnings. Fixed-length, natural-EOS and ultra-long tests are separate; use the per-request timing follow-up for ultra-long conclusions.
